items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I’ve done several albums with him.

ctx.x: He had Benny Golson, Thad Jones, let’s see who else, I can’t really remember. Did he have Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis? I can’t remember all the guys that was on the date but it was great. Very nice. I’ve done several albums with him.
Have you always stuck with the acoustic bass?
